description: This file defines a final class 'Header' within the GuzzleHttp PsR7 namespace. The class provides static methods to parse and normalize HTTP header values, including handling parameters and comma-separated headers.

classes.name: Header
classes.description: Provides static methods for parsing and normalizing HTTP header fields.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses an array of header values containing ';' separated data into an array of associative arrays representing header key-value pairs.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Converts header values with comma-separated entries into a normalized array of individual header parts.
